lines.say: Stop typing nice poster. Most image tools can't clear that up.
They don't draw. They clean up random noise step by step, like wiping a foggy mirror.
Your words guide each wipe. Red auto, rain, night.
Nice poster guides nothing, so the fog stays.
Name the thing, weather and time, and it wipes clear.
The catch: text and hands still often go wrong. Check before posting.
lines.show: The catch: check text and hands.
